network.tdh.shared.difftest.found.1: Every value equal, half the cases with netting and half without. 20 inputs that some programs judged valid and others did not (F1); the edge probes raised seven questions (E1 to E7).
network.tdh.shared.difftest.found.2: Which inputs are valid (F2, F3); three registry lists the Rust core could not read (F4), one of which the Python reference ignored (F5); an event’s default use case and logs marked removed (E8, E9).
network.tdh.shared.difftest.found.3: Lean, Python and program B equal on all 30,000 main cases. Two faults the Rust core had carried over from the Rust reference: registry numbers of 2¹²⁸ or more (F6) and a cutoff search at the top block (F7); values outside their type and dates that name no day (E10, E11).
network.tdh.shared.difftest.found.4: Lean and program B equal on all 30,000 main cases. Two defects in reading the vector files: the Rust core refused 199 inputs over a huge amount after the snapshot block (F8), and the Python reference gave 75 inputs a result beside an empty list of raw logs (F9); one question for the vector format (E12).
network.tdh.shared.difftest.settled.2: 6529chain {commit}, October 15: P26, and for E8 the vector format; vectors 61 to 67

network.tdh.shared.difftest.otherVectors: P26’s fifth round (f840096, October 16) added vectors 75 to 88: 76 to 79 settle round 4’s findings, and 75 and 80 to 88 pin its rulings on how each input value is typed and written (a day length as a 32-bit number, JSON integers and keys in one canonical form, the claim limit as a 32-bit number, one log per position). D136 (3bfa7b0, October 18) added vectors 89 to 103 for the four-wallet consolidation, which round 6 tested. None changes a value of the 2026-10-11 cycle.
network.tdh.shared.difftest.found.5: All four equal on all 30,000 main cases, and on every ruling of P26’s fifth round. Edge probes found one question for the vector format: a member it does not name in a transfer, an event or the cycle, which program B refuses and the other three ignore (E13).
network.tdh.shared.difftest.found.6: TDH v1.4, with D136’s four-wallet consolidation. All four equal on all 30,000 main cases: 1,187 with a group of four, and on 1,816 the gate decided the groups. The mutations aimed at the four-wallet rule (fresh and old links, the gate’s member, the boundary second, repeated registrations, revocations, ties within a block, five wallets) agree in all four. Edge probes found nothing new; E13 is still open.
